The effective suit a card follows

Source: R/order.R
sk_effective_suit.Rd

In suit and grand games every jack counts as a trump, not as its printed suit, so leading a jack forces trumps rather than that suit. This function returns the suit a card must be followed under, using the sentinel "T" for trump.

Usage

sk_effective_suit(x, game_type, call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

x

An sk_card object or character vector of card codes.

game_type

A single game-type string, one of sk_game_types().

call

The calling environment, used for error reporting.

Value

A character vector the same length as x: one of the suit codes ("C", "S", "H", "D"), or "T" for trump.

See also

sk_legal_moves(), which applies this rule.

Other game-type functions: sk_card_order(), sk_game_types(), sk_is_trump(), sk_strength()

Examples

# In a hearts game the jack of clubs is a trump, not a club.
sk_effective_suit(c("CJ", "HA", "D10"), "hearts")
#> [1] "T" "T" "D"
# In a null game it is simply a club.
sk_effective_suit(c("CJ", "HA", "D10"), "null")
#> [1] "C" "H" "D"
